name: Refugie
description: Contrebassiste logistique assurant le maintien des lignes de ravitaillement entre les zones contestées.

subject.archetype: Scrap-punk Logistics Combatant, heavily augmented and armored for frontline supply line defense

loadout.armor_outfit: Improvised heavy-duty mining space suit, asymmetrically patched with rusty steel plates from old signage, welded car body panels, and thick duct tape layers. Overloaded with cables, exposed copper wires, industrial belts, and scruffy work clothes soaked in grease and grime. Helmet is a cracked welder's visor with opaque scratched visor and dangling wires.
loadout.arsenal: Militarized mining kinetic hammer (salvaged thruster welded to a heavy industrial drill), modified to fire plasma bursts. Secondary weapon: a hand-mounted plasma cutter gauntlet that channels dark corruption energy through fingertips.

attitude.behavior: Low sweeping strike, arm fully extended toward an adjacent enemy, body leaning into the blow. The dark corruption tendrils burst from the fingertips, burrowing into the enemy's armor with visible weakening effects. Combat stance is aggressive, low, and dynamic.
attitude.emotion: Intense, adrenaline-fueled focus, desperate determination, and savage aggression in the heat of battle.

palette_names.name: Oxidized Steel Gray
palette_names.role: Primary armor and environmental metal, dominant background tone

palette_names.name: Rusty Orange
palette_names.role: Accent on corroded plates, rust streaks, and warm highlights

palette_names.name: Blue Plasma Glow
palette_names.role: Energy accents from weapons and plasma impacts, cool contrast

palette_names.name: Yellow-Orange Sparks
palette_names.role: Sparks and debris from impacts, dynamic light sources

palette_names.name: Dirty Work Clothes Brown
palette_names.role: Secondary clothing tones, grime and stains

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic mixed lighting: harsh blue plasma glow from weapons and impacts, warm orange sparks from debris, ambient dusty smoke with volumetric lighting, low-key shadows to emphasize grit.
color_and_light.mood: Chaotic, intense, menacing, desperate survival atmosphere

camera.angle: Low angle with slight dutch tilt, dynamic perspective to match the sweeping strike and convey motion

scenography.setting: Active warzone at an asteroid waystation crossroads: corrugated metal walls pockmarked with plasma impacts, makeshift barricades built from shipping containers and scrap, exposed pipelines, flickering emergency lights, thick smoke drifting through the corridor, debris littering the ground.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Plasma rounds impacting nearby walls, sending showers of sparks and debris raining down. Blue energy bursts and orange sparks illuminate the smoky environment. Enemy silhouettes advancing through smoke, allied forces taking cover behind barricades. Dust particles and smoke lit by plasma glow, slight lens flare from energy weapons.
